summary: iter366 similar-items consolidation tested end-to-end. Backend suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter366_similar_items.py (7 tests) reruns green. UI flows on /shipments verified against a throwaway shipment created via API and cleaned up: Similar-items toolbar button opens the dialog; summary line reports '2 groups · 2 extra lines · 1 across boxes · 5 items scanned'; strict/normal/loose buttons re-scan; Blankets group shows 2-different-boxes badge + 'Boxes 24 & 25' + combined preview 16 pcs · $80; unticking blanket row drops preview to 10 pcs · $50 and reticking restores; Combine into one line produces consolidated=true item qty=16, unit $5, box_label='Boxes 24 & 25'; Combine only what shares the kept box returns 400 with toast 'Nothing to merge in that box' and data is untouched; Kitchen-pots group is flagged 'Looks like the same line typed twice' and 'Delete the ticked repeats' removes only the duplicate leaving the kept row at qty 4; 'Keep separate' removes the group from the session without mutating data; manifest.pdf and commercial-invoice.pdf both return %PDF after consolidation; toolbar regressions (AI HS codes, Print Manifest, Scan Boxes, Item, etc.) all still render.

issues: 'Hide packed' filter is on by default, and consolidated items live in a box so they also get hidden. That means the new 'Split back' button (data-testid ship-item-split-<id>) is not in the DOM until the user unchecks 'Hide packed'. Not a functional bug, but worth surfacing in the tooltip/help text so admins can find undo.

action_items: Optional: when an item becomes consolidated, ensure it is visible even when 'Hide packed' is on (or surface a small hint) so the 'Split back' button is discoverable.
critical_code_review_comments: SimilarItemsDialog.jsx: state.picks include-set is initialised from group.items on load; when the user unticks a row the preview qty/value correctly recompute — good.

act() in the dialog uses (pick.name || group.label).trim() as the combined-line name; if a user clears the field it silently falls back to the label — consider disabling combine when the name is empty rather than substituting.
ShipmentsAdminPage.jsx: 'Similar items' button is disabled when items.length < 2 — correct guard.
Backend routes in /app/backend/routers/shipments_pkg/similar.py return a clean 400 for combine_same_box when nothing shares the kept box — verified via UI toast.
